name: Story lines
what: A story or a quote told card by card: lines fade up out of a blur one after another, the key words bright; or a colour per card with one big serif keyword typed, slid or risen in.

learned_from.what: the dark vignette, lines fading in ~15 f, 6-10 f apart, the key phrase white
a colour per card cut on the change, the big serif keyword, a different entrance per card, the dots
the light look: a serif title on white, soft fades

motion: per line 14 f (blur up, power2.out), 9 f apart; a card fades 12 f before the next; keywords typed 2 f a letter / slid 18 f / risen 20 f
min_why: each card needs ~75 frames (~16 empty frames at a change, its key words typed over ~30): a shorter card is cut mid-word - for short cards use highlight-reveal or a kinetic text template
